Lessons.Title: Add and Subtract Within 1,000,000
ExplanationParagraphs:
Learning goal: You will add and subtract within 1,000,000 with multiple compositions or decompositions.
In this lesson, you use the standard algorithm for addition and subtraction to the hundred-thousands place. You build your fluency with the algorithm as you encounter examples where more than one digit has to be decomposed in order to subtract.
Core relationship: Accurate addition/subtraction through 1,000,000. Use algorithms with correctly aligned digits, then estimate and verify the result.

Local publisher 2021 source lesson activities: Warm-up:  Notice and Wonder: Subtracting Tens of Thousands	 (10 minutes); Activity 1:  Add and Subtract Large Numbers	 (15 minutes); Activity 2:  Spot Errors	 (20 minutes); Cool-down:  Subtract (5 minutes)
Original visual/physical and peer-explanation activities still require teacher review.
